translations.literal: None failed to bind favor close, knot intimacy tight—dreaming of Hui Shi and Zhuang Zhou's clear dust, reaching for Yang and Zuo's bright merit.
translations.idiomatic: All bound favor close and knotted intimacy tight—dreaming of Hui Shi and Zhuang Zhou's clear dust, reaching for Yang and Zuo's bright merit.

sentences.zh: 及瞑目東越，歸骸雒浦，繐帳猶懸，門罕漬酒之彥；

translations.literal: Then his eyes closed in eastern Yue and his bones went home to the Luo ford; the mourning curtain still hung, yet at the gate scarcely a worthy soul came to steep the wine.
translations.idiomatic: Then his eyes closed in eastern Yue and his bones went home to the Luo ford; the mourning curtain still hung, yet scarcely a worthy soul came to steep the gate in wine.

sentences.zh: 墳未宿草，野絕動輪之賓。

translations.literal: The mound had not yet taken last year's grass; in the wild, no guest turned the carriage wheels.
translations.idiomatic: The mound had not yet taken last year's grass; in the wild, no guest turned carriage wheels.

sentences.zh: 藐爾諸孤，朝不謀夕，流離大海之南，寄命瘴癘之地。

translations.literal: How slight those orphans were—morning without a plan for evening, cast adrift to the great sea's south, their lives entrusted to the land of miasma.
translations.idiomatic: How slight those orphans—morning without a plan for evening, cast adrift to the great sea's south, lives entrusted to the land of miasma.

sentences.zh: 自昔把臂之英，金蘭之友，曾無羊舌下泣之仁，寧慕郈成分宅之德。

translations.literal: Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends of old—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who now would divide a house as Zou did for Cheng's orphans?
translations.idiomatic: Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who would divide a house as Zou did for Cheng's orphans?

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 世路險巇，一至於此！

translations.literal: The world's road is perilous—even to this!
translations.idiomatic: The world's road is perilous—even to this!

sentences.zh: 太行孟門，寧云嶄絕。

translations.literal: Mount Taihang, Meng Gate—are they not called sheer?
translations.idiomatic: Mount Taihang, Meng Gate—are they not called sheer?

sentences.zh: 是以耿介之士，疾其若斯，裂裳裹足，棄之長祇。

translations.literal: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,

sentences.zh: 獨立高山之頂，歡與麋鹿同羣，皦皦然絕其雰濁，誠恥之也，誠畏之也。」

translations.literal: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."
translations.idiomatic: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."

sentences.zh: 昉撰《雜傳》二百四十七卷，《地記》二百五十二卷，文章三十三卷。

translations.literal: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in two hundred forty-seven scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in two hundred fifty-two scrolls, and literary works in thirty-three scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in 252 scrolls, and literary works in 33 scrolls.

sentences.zh: 昉第四子東里，頗有父風，官至尚書外兵郎。

translations.literal: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.

sentences.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：觀夫二漢求賢，率先經術；

translations.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Considering how the two Han sought the worthy, they put classical learning first;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: In the two Han they sought the worthy and put classical learning first;

sentences.zh: 近世取人，多由文史。

translations.literal: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.
translations.idiomatic: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.

sentences.zh: 二子之作，辭藻壯麗，允值其時。

translations.literal: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.
translations.idiomatic: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.

sentences.zh: 淹能沉靜，昉持內行，並以名位終始，宜哉。

translations.literal: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—they both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.
translations.idiomatic: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.

sentences.zh: 江非先覺，任無舊恩，則上秩顯贈，亦末由也已。

translations.literal: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, then high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.
translations.idiomatic: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.
